Frequently asked questions

FAQs

Can’t find your answer? We reply to every email.

Contact us
Where in Dublin is it?

We’re confirming the venue now. The waitlist hears first, then everyone with a ticket.

Can I come to just one day?

Yes. Saturday’s conference is the main day and the simplest way in. The Sunday gala and the Friday Exclusive Founders Day come with the fuller tickets.

What happens on the Friday?

An exclusive founders day, limited to 20 seats, that runs into the evening, with hot seats, workshops and roundtables with industry experts. Topics cover branding, YouTube, paid advertising, leadership, scaling and agency growth, and there’s a $500k/year revenue minimum. Dinner is included.

What should I wear to the gala?

Black tie. The gala is in a castle-style venue, with the awards and live music.

Who should attend?

Founders serious about the long game who want to be in a room with people ahead of them, on the same path.
